{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
'''Subspace''' was the medium used for long-range communications such as [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|subspace radio]], [[sub-space image transmitter]]s and subspace transponders. It was a distinct dimension from [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]], like [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and [[otherspace]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Memoryalpha:Star Trek|''Star Trek'']], subspace is both the primary form of radio communication used by [[Memoryalpha:Starfleet|Starfleet]], and the analog to Warp, which creates subspace bubbles around ships, allowing faster-than-light travel. Messages sent through subspace can bypass the physical light-speed limitations of real space, allowing for near-instantaneous communication in the ''Star Trek'' universe.

Subspace also appears in the [[Wikipedia:Stargate|''Stargate'' series]] as the analog to the hyperspace dimension. Subspace has been seen as an element of faster-than-light travel on a number of occasions.

Subspace is also seen in space battleship yamato 2199 in the form of [https://yamato.fandom.com/wiki/Subspace_gate subspace gates] which are used extensively by the [https://yamato.fandom.com/wiki/Great_Garmillas_Empire garmillan empire] and are ancient [https://yamato.fandom.com/wiki/Archelias Archelian] artefacts, connected to each other by subspace corridors, which are effectively a different dimension similar to the way hyperspace works in Star wars.
